The VDV lines are every regional licence of ČSAD AUTOBUSY České Budějovice (VDV contract areas Humpolecko 357xxx and Pelhřimovsko 358xxx, and its Jindřichův Hradec line 340905) with a stop in Pelhřimov; line number = the last three digits. Not here: 358401 (PID 401, on the PID Benešovsko sheet) and the long-distance lines to Praha 350410 and 350804.

1.note: Pelhřimov's main town line: the silo (industrial zone, west) – bus station – Táborská / Starý Pelhřimov (housing, east), 42 trips, most of them at the shift changes (5:00–7:30, 14:00–14:45), run through the afternoon by one bus in a fixed sequence: silo 14:40 → Táborská, Táborská 15:30 → silo, silo 15:45 → Starý Pelhřimov, Starý Pelhřimov 16:15 → silo, then silo 16:35 → Táborská. That sequence is one circuit every 120 (exact at 14:40, 15:30, 15:45 and 16:15; 16:35 is 5 min off its repeat), one bus; two separate Simutrans lines (Táborská, Starý Pelhřimov) would need two. The 14:00–14:45 shift extras (silo 14:00 and 14:20, Táborská 14:25, Starý Pelhřimov 14:45), the 16:15 silo → Táborská and the short Táborská – bus station trips (16:35, 16:55, 17:25) run over stops of this circuit and are off the pattern. Read at the bus station, 13:00–18:00 has 9 trips each way and the circuit passes it 5 times each way: the rest is the shift-change work of a second and third bus (14:00–14:45 at the silo) at no repeating minute (passing check: no branch, ≥ 3 each way at one minute, is hidden there).

3.note: A loop from the bus station run both ways: via the railway station, the hospital (nemocnice II) and Pod Dolní branou, back by Architekta Janáka and Pod Floriánem (trips reach Architekta Janáka 17–24 min out), or the other way round via Pod Floriánem first and Karlovo náměstí (8–9 min out). Each way is its own Simutrans line (one route each). Whole day via the station: 6:45, 7:15, 9:25, 10:25, 11:10, 14:05, 14:55, 16:15, 16:50, 18:25; via Pod Floriánem: 4:40, 6:00, 6:36, 7:50, 10:00, 12:05, 12:57, 15:15, 15:45, 16:57, 17:30 – about every 30 min in the afternoon between the two, at no fixed minute. Step 4 (method v4: a passing pattern is used where one exists): via the station every 180 at 16:15 and 16:50 (also 13:15, 13:50, 19:15 …; 7:15 exact too), via Pod Floriánem every 240 at 15:45 and 16:57 (also 12:57, 19:45 …), 5 real departures on the minute in the afternoon. 14:05, 14:55, 15:15, 17:30 and 18:25 are off the pattern. One bus each. A single line every 60 alternating the two ways (:15 / :45) would keep the half-hourly rhythm but hits only 15:45 and 16:15. The way via the station follows the 14:05 path by Křemešnická (its slot trips run via the railway station, Modřínová and Pod Hájkem, which the other way serves), the other way the 15:15 path by Skrýšov, so every stop of the loop is on a line. The passing check reads the loop at Čajkovského, which both ways pass, so it counts every trip as one way.

250.note: VDV regional line Pelhřimov – Humpolec – Havlíčkův Brod, Dopravní terminál: hourly through the day, leaving Pelhřimov at :43 (13:53 and 17:48 are 10 and 5 min off) and Havlíčkův Brod at :12 (13:02 is 10 min off; 18:15 and 19:15 wait for trains), 64 min, 3 buses. Short trips Pelhřimov – Humpolec, Poliklinika: out at 13:18, 15:13, 17:18 and 18:43 (and 14:10 from the silo), back at 14:07 and 18:07. Read at the Poliklinika, 5 go out and 2 come back in the afternoon: the buses sleep at the Humpolec garage (provozovna Oblast Humpolecko), so the short line runs at its inbound rate, every 240 (13:18 / 17:18 out, 14:07 / 18:07 back), and the other out trips are off the pattern (buses going home; to be confirmed by the plates on Tue 24 Nov). Kojčice, Dehtáře (with Vadčice) and Velký Rybník, obec are village stops off the main road that only a few trips serve (15:13 out; 15:12 and 13:02 in from Havlíčkův Brod); every place is served, so the short line runs through them, 6 min longer than its slot trips take.

259.note: Humpolec – Zachotín – Pelhřimov, a few trips a day: Pelhřimov → Humpolec 5:37, 9:37, 12:30, 14:38, 17:37; back 6:34, 9:32, 13:29, 15:32 (read at Humpolec, autobusové nádraží; some trips start or end at Humpolec, Kuchařov). Every 240: out 9:37 / 13:37 / 17:37 (5:37, 9:37 and 17:37 exact), back 13:32 (9:32 exact, 13:29 3 min). 12:30 and 14:38 are off the pattern. 259 Mysletín is the Humpolec end's own run through Bystrá (Mysletín 14:02 → Humpolec, Kuchařov, back 14:29), every 480, the only service of Bystrá and Bystrá, Březina.

301.note: Pelhřimov – Červená Řečice – Hořepník – Lukavec, every 120 both ways all day: Pelhřimov at :33 in even hours (10:33, 14:30, 16:33, 18:33), Lukavec at :23 (4:23 … 16:23). Out via Dubovice, as the 14:30 runs (the only trips into the village).

305.note: Pacov – Leskovice – Nová Cerekev: Pacov 13:18 and 15:18, Nová Cerekev 14:03 and 16:03 (and 6:22 / 7:03 in the morning). Every 120, one bus; modelled at 14:30, where the pattern runs (it ends with the 16:03; 17:33 to Litohošť is a bus going home).

258.note: Pelhřimov – Svépravice – Želiv: out at :37 in even hours (12:37, 14:37 to Lhotice; 16:37, 18:37 end at Želiv, restaurace), back from Lhotice at :37 in odd hours (13:37, 15:37; 17:55 from the restaurant). Every 120, read at Želiv, restaurace so the short trips count.

280.note: Pelhřimov – Nová Cerekev – Černovice, hourly from Pelhřimov at :38: even hours to Černovice (12:38, 14:38, 16:38, 18:38), odd hours to Nová Cerekev (13:38, 15:38). Back from Černovice at :37 (even hours) and from Nová Cerekev at :00 (14:00, 16:00). Ex4: two Simutrans lines every 120, all slots exact.

281.note: Pelhřimov – Božejov – Kamenice nad Lipou: Kamenice trips are few (out 10:57, 14:57, 16:57; back 4:37, 6:22, 10:22): every 240 (10:57 / 14:57 out, 6:22 / 10:22 back); 16:57 is a bus going to Kamenice for the night. Afternoon shuttles to Libkova Voda at :40 (13:40, 14:40, 15:40), back at :01: 281 Libkova Voda every 60, modelled at 15:00 inside its run.

290.note: Pelhřimov – Mezná – Častrov – Žirovnice – Počátky: Pelhřimov at :34 in even hours (12:34, 14:34 to Počátky; 16:34, 18:34 to Žirovnice, read there), Počátky at :31 (12:31, 14:31, 16:31). Every 120.

300.note: Jihlava – Vyskytná – Pelhřimov – Pacov. Jihlava → Pacov runs through hourly (Jihlava :40, Pelhřimov :31, Pacov :10); the other way not every bus runs through (Pacov :50 → Pelhřimov, some ending there; Pelhřimov :34 → Jihlava, some starting there), so the line is split at Pelhřimov: 300 Jihlava every 60 (Jihlava :40, Pelhřimov :34; 16 and 11 exact) and 300 Pacov every 60 (Pelhřimov :31, Pacov :50; 14:36 is 5 min late, the one slot off). The Jihlava :10 extras (13:10, 14:10, 15:10, via Vyskytná, rozcestí and Opatov) have one trip back (14:04): buses going to the Pelhřimov garage, off the pattern. Back from Pacov via Dobrá Voda u Pacova, as the 15:47 runs (its only afternoon trip).

320.note: Pelhřimov – Nový Rychnov – Rohozná, every 120 all afternoon: Pelhřimov :35 in even hours, Rohozná :25 in odd hours, all exact. Out via Losy samota, as the 14:35 runs (its only trip).

321.note: Pelhřimov – Vyskytná – Nový Rychnov: Pelhřimov :35 in odd hours (13:35, 15:35, 17:35), Nový Rychnov :55 in even hours (12:55, 14:55). Every 120. 321 Jankov is the Nový Rychnov bus's loop by Opatov and Jankov (14:24, back to Nový Rychnov 14:54), every 480, the only service of Jankov, obec.

324.note: Pelhřimov – Pavlov – Černov – Horní Cerekev: out 12:40 and 17:40 (to the square), 14:40 (to the station); back from the station 13:32 and 15:32. Every 120 (Pelhřimov :40 even hours, read at the square; station :32 odd hours), modelled at 14:30; 17:40 is a bus going to Horní Cerekev for the night.

325.note: Pelhřimov – Rynárec – Horní Cerekev: out hourly at :38 (13:38–16:38), back at 14:57 and 15:59 (and Horní Ves 12:50). Read at Horní Cerekev, 4 out and 2 back: buses sleep at Horní Cerekev / Horní Ves. Every 60 at the inbound rate, modelled at 15:00 (14:38, 15:38 out; 14:59, 15:59 back); 13:38 and 16:38 are off the pattern. Out through Vokov and Dobrá Voda, as the 15:38 runs (the villages' only afternoon trip); the 14:38 goes by the road past Rynárecká and ACHP, which the town lines serve.

326.note: Pelhřimov – Střítež pod Křemešníkem – Žirov: out 6:17, 14:42, 16:32; back 4:50, 6:50, 15:15. Every 480 (14:42 / 15:15), one bus; 16:32 is the bus going to Žirov for the night.

925.note: Pelhřimov – Počátky – Žirovnice – Stojčín / Popelín. Pelhřimov → Počátky hourly at :35 (even hours end at Počátky, odd hours go on), and every bus back passes Počátky at :50: 925 every 60, exact both ways. Beyond Počátky, Ex4 lines: 925 Stojčín (Počátky :00 in odd hours to Stojčín, the railway station; back :30) every 120, and 925 Popelín (on from the odd-hour Pelhřimov trips, Počátky :10; back from Popelín :36) every 120. 14:10 to Žirovnice is off the pattern.

905.note: Jindřichův Hradec – Nová Včelnice – Kamenice nad Lipou – Pelhřimov (Jihočeský licence, ČSAD AUTOBUSY ČB). Hourly: Pelhřimov at :49 in odd hours and :34 in even hours in the late afternoon (12:39, 14:39 earlier: the afternoon wins), Jindřichův Hradec at :07 / :12. Every 120 with two slots each way. The :34 trips run through Ondřejov and Myslotín, the :49 ones by the Ondřejov bypass: the line follows the village path (Myslotín's only service). Back via Jindřichův Hradec, Průmyslová, as the 14:12 runs. 905 Nová Včelnice is the hourly Jindřichův Hradec – Nová Včelnice shuttle (13:27, 14:32 … back :02), every 120 with two slots, through Jarošov, Lovětín as the 13:27 and 15:27 run.

302.note: Pelhřimov – Krasíkovice – Hodějovice – Pelhřimov, a loop run twice a day (7:22, 14:02): the only service of Hodějovice, so its own line every 480 at 14:02.

unmodelled.2: Shift and school line silo – bus station – hospital – Táborská (20 trips, 4 in the afternoon: 13:00, 13:30, 14:15, 14:45, and 22:15). Every stop it serves is on lines 1 and 3, so it gets no line of its own (method Step 8: a long-interval line only where it is a place's only service).
unmodelled.4: Shift line bus station – silo – Osvobození / Starý Pelhřimov (12 trips: 5:03–6:51, 14:31–15:10, 22:45). Every stop is on lines 1 and 3; not modelled (Step 8).

pak.why: VDV regional buses (white with the green VDV chevrons) take VZ-VDV-bus, which has the Crossway LE LINE 10,8M and 14,5M; the ICOM town buses take the town package VZ-MHDPelhrimov-bus. The Crossway LE LINE 12M in VDV paint and the Isuzu Novociti Life in ICOM blue with a white fade were drawn for this sheet by the art session (simutrans-122-0-c1, pakset main 03e77e8, 23 Nov 2026) from photos of 7J0 8266; any further type goes there.

texts.buses: The VDV live map (mapavdv.kr-vysocina.cz, Kraj Vysočina) polled every minute on Tuesday 24 Nov 2026 gives every bus's licence and trip number (the JDF trip) and its VDV vehicle number; the ČSAD buses also show their number plate, which joins them to the seznam-autobusu.cz register (read on 23 Nov 2026 in the owner's browser). The register lists no fleet numbers for ICOM or ČSAD, so a bus is named by its VDV vehicle number with its plate; a town bus the map shows without a plate keeps its VDV number and its type stays unknown. A bus fills one Simutrans line it ran in that line's window, by matching.
texts.depots: ICOM transport, provozovna Pelhřimov (the town buses; its four Isuzu Novociti Life run MHD Pelhřimov) and ČSAD AUTOBUSY České Budějovice, provozovny Oblast Pelhřimovsko and Oblast Humpolecko (the VDV lines; the register files their buses at Pelhřimov and Humpolec).
texts.status_html: Version 2, 23 Nov 2026: every VDV line from Pelhřimov added; the buses come in version 3. The VDV live map keeps no history, so it is polled all day on Tuesday 24 Nov; version 3 names the real bus on every Simutrans line. The lines, typed values and bus counts here stand unless that day shows buses pairing lines in a way the timetable hides.

coverage_exceptions.Vyskytná, rozcestí: A roadside stop of Vyskytná (whose village stop is on 300 and 321), served in the afternoon only by 300's Jihlava :10 extras (13:10, 14:10, 15:10; one back, 14:04), which are off the pattern: three one way and one back is no branch.
